scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild scripts/set-role.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/set-role.cjs && esbuild scripts/set-password.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/set-password.cjs && esbuild scripts/migrate-users.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/migrate-users.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:server
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test tests/triage-heuristic.test.ts tests/triage-model.test.ts tests/voice-commands.test.ts tests/geo.test.ts tests/specialties.test.ts tests/hospital-data.test.ts tests/facility-model.test.ts tests/platform.test.ts tests/ai-models.test.ts tests/consent-rules.test.ts tests/lab-values.test.ts tests/build-env.test.ts
scripts.test:server: node scripts/dev-firebase.mjs --no-persist "tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/access-matrix.test.ts tests/resource-ownership.test.ts tests/booking.test.ts tests/consent.test.ts tests/provider-admin.test.ts tests/consultations.test.ts tests/messages.test.ts tests/checkin.test.ts"
